title: naive 与 aware datetime：混算被禁止、贴标签与真换算的区别
expected_output:
=== 对象属性 ===
naive             = 2026-01-01 12:00:00
naive.tzinfo      = None
aware             = 2026-01-01 12:00:00+00:00
aware.tzinfo      = UTC
aware.utcoffset() = 0:00:00

=== 同类相减: naive - naive 可以 ===
naive2 - naive = 1 day, 0:00:00

=== 混减: naive - aware 被拒绝 ===
TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes

=== aware - aware 正常, 且按绝对时刻算 ===
同一时刻的上海表示 = 2026-01-01 20:00:00+08:00
aware - shanghai   = 0:00:00 (同一瞬间, 差 0)

=== 给 naive 贴标签 vs 真换算 ===
replace(tzinfo=+8)   -> 2026-01-01 12:00:00+08:00 (只贴标签, 数值不变)
假设它是 UTC 再转 +8 -> 2026-01-01 20:00:00+08:00 (真换算, 加 8 小时)

=== 结论 ===
naive 与 aware 的混算被 Python 主动禁止; 语义不同必须显式 replace 或 astimezone
code:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

naive = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0)
aware = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

print("=== 对象属性 ===")
print("naive             =", naive)
print("naive.tzinfo      =", naive.tzinfo)
print("aware             =", aware)
print("aware.tzinfo      =", aware.tzinfo)
print("aware.utcoffset() =", aware.utcoffset())

print()
print("=== 同类相减: naive - naive 可以 ===")
print("naive2 - naive =", datetime(2026, 1, 2, 12, 0) - naive)

print()
print("=== 混减: naive - aware 被拒绝 ===")
try:
    naive - aware
except TypeError as e:
    print("TypeError:", e)

print()
print("=== aware - aware 正常, 且按绝对时刻算 ===")
shanghai = aware.astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=8)))
print("同一时刻的上海表示 =", shanghai)
print("aware - shanghai   =", aware - shanghai, "(同一瞬间, 差 0)")

print()
print("=== 给 naive 贴标签 vs 真换算 ===")
t = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0)
print("replace(tzinfo=+8)   ->", t.replace(tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))), "(只贴标签, 数值不变)")
print("假设它是 UTC 再转 +8 ->", t.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))), "(真换算, 加 8 小时)")

print()
print("=== 结论 ===")
print("naive 与 aware 的混算被 Python 主动禁止; 语义不同必须显式 replace 或 astimezone")
